# EscortRS1600 — CMR4 native Escort bank
Preserve original WAV names, bytes and sample rates. Re-extract with tools/audio/cmr4_escort.py.
manifest.json records source hashes and estimated RPM mapping; estimates are not decoded original curves.
Consumer: rally_vehicle_audio.gd. Engine/exhaust use stat, thr and coast idle layers.
loadoff are lift events, not verified combustion backfires. Ignition/stall are inventory only.
Do not apply old Rally Trophy/CMR2 EQ or RPM calibration to these samples.
